components.description: Today, Progress, Account. Horizontal by default, vertical at desktop, fixed along the bottom on phones in the app.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Main navigation"><button aria-current="page" class="active"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3v4m8-4v4M4 10h16M5 5h14a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v14H4V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1Z"/></svg>Today</button><button><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 4v16h16M8 16v-4m5 4V7m5 9v-6"/></svg>Progress</button><button><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16 7a4 4 0 1 1-8 0 4 4 0 0 1 8 0ZM4 21v-2a8 8 0 0 1 16 0v2"/></svg>Account</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:20px 0;background:var(--bg)}.ds-nav button{font-family:"Manrope Variable",sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;touch-action:manipulation;padding:10px 18px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-weight:650}.ds-nav button:hover{background:var(--tint)}.ds-nav .active{background:var(--tint);color:var(--accent)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}@media(min-width:1000px){.ds-nav{position:absolute;top:140px;flex-direction:column;width:140px}.ds-nav button{justify-content:flex-start}}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-nav{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);z-index:20;justify-content:space-around;gap:0;padding:8px 12px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}.ds-nav button{flex:1;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;font-size:10px;padding:8px 12px}.ds-nav .active{background:none;color:var(--accent)}.ds-nav .active svg{stroke-width:2.3}}

components.name: Completed Agenda Row
components.description: Checked circle, struck-through title, metadata, and edit action; source component uses React state for toggling.
components.css: .ds-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;min-height:94px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink)}.ds-row button{font-family:"Manrope Variable",sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;touch-action:manipulation;}.ds-row button:hover{background:var(--tint)}.ds-row button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-row .ds-complete{width:48px;height:48px;min-width:48px;padding:8px;position:relative;color:var(--accent-ink)}.ds-complete:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:27px;height:27px;border:1.5px solid var(--accent);border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}.ds-complete svg{position:relative;z-index:1}.ds-row .ds-content{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;gap:5px;flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:left;padding:12px 0;border-radius:0}.ds-row .ds-content:hover{background:none}.ds-name{font-size:16px;font-weight:650;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-thickness:1px;color:var(--muted)}.ds-meta{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-row .ds-edit{color:var(--muted);width:44px;height:44px;padding:10px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-row{gap:8px}.ds-name{font-size:15px}.ds-meta{font-size:11px}.ds-row .ds-edit{width:44px;padding:8px;flex-shrink:0}.ds-row .ds-complete{width:44px;min-width:44px;padding:6px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-complete:before{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A calm working space for daily plans: warm white, charcoal text, and a restrained green accent. Manrope, open spacing, and thin dividers create a clean, premium feel without ornamental clutter.

The system prioritizes a legible agenda and visible completion controls on an Android phone. Light, dark, and system appearance share the same structure; only semantic color roles change. The implemented interface uses type, line icons, and simple data marks rather than photographic imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces with restrained green emphasis.
Clear type hierarchy and flat, divided lists.
Persistent, labeled Today, Progress, and Account navigation.
Explicit completion, saved, loading, and error states.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Use the CSS color roles in every state so light, dark, and system appearance remain coherent.

rules.name: The Flat Agenda Rule
rules.body: Keep routine content on the page surface; reserve elevation for transient status feedback.

dos: Do use semantic CSS variables for every theme-sensitive surface and state.
Do retain visible labels for the three navigation destinations.
Do pair completion color with the checkmark and struck-through title.
Do distinguish no recorded plan from zero completion.
Do keep keyboard outlines and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't add ornamental clutter to the quiet daily agenda direction.
Don't turn every agenda row or settings section into an elevated card.
Don't hard-code light colors into shared component states.
Don't communicate save or error status through color alone.
